seo_title: Frnds — pizza, breakfast and delivery in Esil district
seo_description: Frnds in Astana's Esil district: 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street. Breakfast all day, dine-in, takeaway and our own delivery. Open daily 09:00–23:00.
h1: We're in the Esil district — drop by like a neighbour, or order in
body:
Frnds sits in the Esil district at 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street, among residential courtyards rather than in a mall window. We're open every day from nine in the morning to eleven at night — no days off, no lunch breaks. If you live in one of the buildings nearby, there's nothing to get ready for: come down in whatever you wear at home and decide at the table whether it's coffee, a late breakfast or pizza straight away. We built Frnds to be a home away from home, so everything here stays in plain sight: an open kitchen, an open bar, one big communal table and a photo wall that everyone who keeps coming back lands on sooner or later.

The main thing a neighbour should know about our kitchen: breakfast doesn't end at noon. We cook it the whole time the door is open — a rule with no exceptions and no fine print. Slept through Saturday? You've missed nothing. Came home from a night shift and woke up at sunset? Your omelette is right where it should be. And when breakfast isn't the mood, the rest of the menu steps in: pizza, fresh pasta, soups and desserts. The day here moves at a neighbourhood pace — quiet mornings that smell of coffee, a louder lunch hour, and evenings when the tables fill with the same faces that hurried past our windows in the morning.

Now for the news: Frnds has its own delivery. Orders travel with our own couriers, not with whoever happened to be around, so dinner reaches your flat hot. If the evening turns out to be a couch evening and even a jacket feels like too much, message us on WhatsApp at +7 707 480 92 15, put your order together and wait for the doorbell. The morning cup of coffee on the way to work, though, is still better picked up in person — some things are simply nicer handed over the counter.

Come by without an occasion or a schedule: with a pram after a walk, with a laptop instead of an office, with a kid after school, alone with a book — every one of those days fits here. The kitchen's daily life is on Instagram at @frnds.kz, but our windows are big: glance in on your way home, it's more honest than any feed. We're here every day until eleven at night, and the place works best when the tables are taken by people from the buildings next door.
landmarks: We're at 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street — the left bank, the residential part of the Esil district, between courtyards and offices. The landmark is simple: the Frnds sign above the door.
cta: Come down in your home clothes or write to WhatsApp at +7 707 480 92 15 — breakfast will wait for you late into the evening, at our place or at yours.
